description: This Java source file defines the 'JetBoyView' class, which is a custom SurfaceView implementing a side-scrolling shooter game with integrated sound and music cues managed via the JetPlayer API. It contains internal classes for handling game events, a thread class for game logic and rendering, and methods for managing game state, drawing graphics, processing input, and integrating music triggers based on gameplay events.

classes.name: GameEvent
classes.description: Base class representing a game event, including system, user input, and JetPlayer events.

classes.name: KeyGameEvent
classes.description: Subclass of GameEvent for key-based user input events.

classes.name: JetGameEvent
classes.description: Subclass of GameEvent for events triggered by JetPlayer, including segment, track, and controller info.

classes.name: JetBoyThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread that manages game logic, rendering, input processing, and JetPlayer event handling.

classes.name: Asteroid
classes.description: Represents an asteroid object in the game, including position and animation state.

classes.name: Explosion
classes.description: Represents an explosion animation triggered upon asteroid destruction.

methods.name: initializeJetPlayer
methods.description: Sets up the JetPlayer instance, loads the JET file, and queues initial segments.

methods.name: doDraw
methods.description: Main drawing method that delegates to state-specific drawing routines.

methods.name: doDrawRunning
methods.description: Renders the game during active gameplay, including background, asteroids, spaceship, laser, and timer.

methods.name: setInitialGameState
methods.description: Initializes game variables and game state for a new game.

methods.name: doAsteroidAnimation
methods.description: Updates and draws asteroid and explosion animations based on game timing.

methods.name: doDrawReady
methods.description: Draws the start (ready) screen.

methods.name: doDrawPlay
methods.description: Draws the main game play screen.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main game loop handling game updates, rendering, and state transitions.

methods.name: updateGameState
methods.description: Processes queued events and updates game objects and state accordingly.

methods.name: processKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key input events to control game interactions.

methods.name: updateLaser
methods.description: Manages laser firing logic and JetPlayer mute flags.

methods.name: updateAsteroids
methods.description: Moves asteroids, checks for hits, and manages asteroid state.

methods.name: updateExplosions
methods.description: Animates explosion effects and removes completed ones.

methods.name: processJetEvent
methods.description: Handles JetPlayer events such as segment triggers and updates music/mute state.

methods.name: doAsteroidCreation
methods.description: Creates and adds new asteroid objects to the game.

methods.name: setRunning
methods.description: Controls the thread's execution state.

methods.name: getGameState
methods.description: Returns current game state.

methods.name: setGameState
methods.description: Sets the current game state.

methods.name: setSurfaceSize
methods.description: Adjusts internal dimensions when the surface size changes.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses game updates and JetPlayer playback.

methods.name: doCountDown
methods.description: Updates game timer and posts appropriate messages for timer display and game over.

methods.name: onJetEvent
methods.description: Receives JetPlayer events, enqueuing them for processing.
